title: Chapter 318 Group Fight Against Chen Mingyu
content:
Chapter 318 Group Fight Against Chen Mingyu

Lu Xue slowly walked to the door, and after a moment of silence, Lu Xue reached out and pushed it away.

A squeak.

The door was pushed open without any obstacles.

And the scene in front of Lu Xue's eyes lit up.

I saw five stone pillars of different colors standing inside the dim room.

Above these five stone pillars, a ball of light floats.

As for the light ball, it is naturally the treasure that Lu Xue is thinking about.

"Xiaoqing, go and get one for me."

"Ah, why did you let me go?"

"If you want to go, just go. There is no such a lot of nonsense, do you still want to eat?"

"Oh, okay."

Ao Qing drooped his head and flew carefully to the stone pillar.

As Ao Qing gently touched the ball of light.

The next moment, the light ball slowly dissipated.

The treasure inside also came to Ao Qing's hands very smoothly.

Obviously, there is no danger.

Seeing this, Lu Xue also breathed a sigh of relief.

"My master, give it."

Ao Qing handed the treasure in his hand to Lu Xue.

After looking at it for a moment, Lu Xue was suddenly a little excited.

I saw this as a small bronze tower, and more importantly, it was an imperial weapon.

A real imperial weapon.

If it were the past, Lu Xue might not even take a look at it.

But now, her treasures have been restricted by her father. Now, there is only one Xuanyuan Sword that can be used.

There is still too little foundation.

Of course, this is understandable. After all, Lu Xue’s treasure is too much higher than the standard for the fairy world.

If you can't help it, Lu Xue won't be able to easily brush this copy of the Immortal World.

Faced with this ownerless imperial weapon, Lu Xue also easily established a connection with this small bronze tower.

"Defensive treasure, the Green Light Tower!"

Lu Xue was a little surprised that this was actually a defensive treasure.

Just inject energy, the small tower can release a divine light to defend against the attack.

It can even block the attack of a late-stage strong man in the Immortal Emperor Realm.

But the energy required is also huge.

Now Lu Xue is still in the Immortal Lord Realm, and it is very expensive to use the imperial weapon.

At this time, Xiao Luo and the others came secretly following the movement.

"Damn, so many good things!"

As soon as the two of them came in, they couldn't help but exclaim.

After a moment.

Xiao Luo and Qin Feng each obtained one imperial weapon, while Lu Xue obtained three.

The bronze beast was defeated by Lu Xue, and the gate was discovered by Lu Xue.

In terms of emotion and reason, Lu Xue also takes up the majority.

Of course, even if Lu Xue did not make any contribution, Xiao Luo and the others would not say anything.

Just talking about Lu Daosheng's kindness to them, they were willing to follow Lu Xue for the rest of their lives.

Qin Feng obtained an emperor-grade immortal sword, which he couldn't let go.

Xiao Luo obtained an imperial armor, and his whole body was shining with dazzling light, and Xiao Luo was also extremely happy.

In addition to that small tower, Lu Xue also obtained a bead and an ancient ring.

The bead is called the Soul-Suppressing Pearl, which directly enters Lu Xue's sea of consciousness. It not only makes Lu Xue's spirit stronger, but also reduces spiritual attacks or even invalidates it.

It can be said to be an extremely rare soul-like imperial treasure.

As for the ancient ring, Lu Xue did not find its function.

As for Ao Qing, Ao Qing doesn't need it.

"Let's go."

After the search, Lu Xue and others left here.

Soon, the few people returned to the hall.

What you see is still the huge bronze statue.

At this time, Lu Xue and others also noticed some new faces in the hall.

Obviously, more and more people have entered the Bronze Palace during this period.

"Huh? It's you?"

At this moment, a familiar voice sounded.

Lu Xue and others looked at it and saw that it was a very handsome man.

Looking at the man, Lu Xue just took a look and recognized the man's identity.

"Chu Lingsheng."

"Huh? Can you recognize this?"

Chu Lingsheng was a little surprised.

You know, he made a lot of preparations to enter the Bronze Palace this time.

Xiao Luo and the others were slightly stunned.

"Chu Lingsheng, aren't you coming?"

Upon hearing this, Chu Lingsheng smiled slightly, "You are all here, why can't I come?"

Lu Xue nodded slightly, "It's good to come here, there are many good things here. If you work hard, I can save some effort."

Hearing Lu Xue's words, the smile on Chu Lingsheng's face suddenly frozen.

Xiao Luo and the others were laughing.

As many people knew, Lu Xue was naturally referring to the conditions Chu Lingsheng agreed to them.

Chu Lingsheng still feels extremely regretful about that condition.

Black slave, even black slave.

More importantly, the ancient battlefield has now been made public.

He could clearly enter under the leadership of the strong academy.

"Lu Xue, I didn't expect that you actually entered the ancient battlefield, and you also entered this bronze palace before us."

At this moment, another sound rang out.

I saw that it was Ye Yan.

At the same time, Dongku and Mancheng also appeared in the hall.

Now, the famous strong men from Tiandi Academy have almost gathered together, only Tang Hao is the only one left.

"Senior brothers, we are all from Tiandi Academy, so we should help each other."

Qin Feng looked at everyone and said with a smile.

Hearing this, Dong Ku smiled faintly and said, "Then what method do you think of helping each other?"

Qin Feng smiled, "Senior Brother Tang Hao should still be fighting with Chen Mingyu now. Chen Mingyu has repeatedly opposed the people of my Tiandi Academy. Since that's the case, why don't we join forces to sanction him?"

When Xiao Luo heard Qin Feng's words, he was very moved.

Not to mention Chu Lingsheng, he was already ready to move at this moment.

Before, it was because no one was Chen Mingyu's opponent, so he temporarily avoided the edge.

Now, with Tang Hao restraining Chen Mingyu, he didn't mind taking action secretly and giving Chen Mingyu a fatal blow.

Anyway, he is not a gentleman.

Ye Yan frowned slightly, obviously he had some objections to the group fight.

Dongku is thinking.

Mancheng scratched his head and said, "It's not good to fight in groups. After all, I, Mancheng, is a well-known person. If this matter is spread, wouldn't it ruin my reputation?"

Hearing Man Cheng's words, Qin Feng's mouth twitched slightly.

Among these people, they are the least likely to look like scholars. They have big muscles, and they are a disciple of the academy. Who would believe that they are?

"Senior Brother Man Cheng, this is a bad statement."

"There are many people and the power is great, and the fire is high. Aren't these people talking about unity as strength?"

"Since the book says that unity is strength, why can't we unite and deal with others?"

Qin Feng's words made Man Cheng stunned, a little bit unable to turn.

The others were surprised.

At this time, Chu Lingsheng shouted, "Okay, a good unity is strength. Junior Brother Qin Feng said it well, I agree."

"Mancheng, don't hesitate. Could it be that you don't believe what is in the book?"

Man Chuang was a little hesitant, and when he heard Chu Lingsheng's words, he really nodded.

Among these people, Chu Lingsheng had the best relationship with him.

Since Chu Lingsheng thought it was right, he had no brains to follow.
